data.one_liner: Provides a standardized way to launch web browsers for testing and tools.
data.what_it_does: Provides a standardized way to launch web browsers for testing and development tools. Currently supports launching Chrome with customizable flags, arguments, and debug ports.
use_when: You need to programmatically launch a web browser from your Dart tools or test environments
You are building testing tools that require interacting with Chrome via debug ports
avoid_when: You need to display web content inside your mobile or desktop application UI
You need a solution that supports multiple non-Chrome web browsers out of the box
strengths: Allows passing arbitrary command-line arguments and custom user-data directories when starting Chrome
Supports debug port attachment for browser inspection
weaknesses: Currently, Chrome is the only supported browser
Limited documentation and examples provided in the README
data.setup_notes: requires Chrome installed on the host system
